boundaries: Native Windows, actual embedded PostgreSQL, owned inert Node/Git processes and synthetic credentials only. No real external provider account or paid model is called.

The old approval failure lacked retained runtime metadata. Subsequent all-true observations do not establish its root cause. The deterministic real late-lease case proves that the new fixture retry preserves the actual stop gate, rather than claiming a production stop-proof repair.
Each run is separate; full and focused results overlap and must not be summed. Name-filtered pending cases in focused runs are not unsupported platform skips.

Workspace-manifest hashing has descriptor and entry identity checks; subsequent SQLite database opening by pathname retains the separately documented TOCTOU boundary. No whole-restoration descriptor-confinement claim is made here.
